subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, an explicit backed-up doctor/status repair, or automatic quarantine on load?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes how OpenClaw treats persisted session state and whether it may discard or rebuild continuity without an operator action.

options.title: Backed-up repair path
options.body: Status/doctor should diagnose the bad store and offer an explicit backed-up reset or repair command before the gateway resumes normal use.

options.title: Diagnostic-only warning
options.body: Status should report path, size, and parse failure with manual recovery instructions while avoiding any source-level state mutation.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Runtime load should move bad state aside and recreate clean state, accepting that session continuity may be lost to restore channel availability.

recommendation.title: Backed-up repair path
recommendation.body: Status/doctor should diagnose the bad store and offer an explicit backed-up reset or repair command before the gateway resumes normal use.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source ownership and recent session/status refactor history point to vincentkoc as the best available routing owner for this product/state decision.
